subject: Medixa pilot: request for short-term sandbox top-up while PO clears
messages:
From: Natalie Rhodes <natalie.rhodes@medixahealth.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@medixahealth.com
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Medixa pilot access

Hi Stephanie,

Quick note — our procurement queue has hit an unexpected legal review and the PO that would convert our sandbox to paid Dedicated capacity is delayed. We have been running proofs and the team needs another ~10 days of uninterrupted sandbox tokens to finish the integrations and executive demo.

Can Redwood provide a short-term token/top-up or a 2-week extension on the current pilot while we get the PO signed? We expect the PO to clear next week but I can't guarantee the exact day. I attached the PO draft and the internal approval memo so you can see where we are.

Appreciate anything you can do — this pilot is critical for our Q3 roadmap.

Thanks,
Natalie Rhodes
Director of Product
Medixa Health

Attachments: PO_pending_Medixa_0427.pdf (application/pdf), approval_memo.txt (text/plain)

From: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
To: Natalie Rhodes <natalie.rhodes@medixahealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Medixa pilot access

Hi Natalie — thanks for the context and for sharing the PO draft.

We can absolutely help keep the pilot warmed while procurement finishes. Proposed immediate next steps from our side:
- Provision a one-time sandbox credit of 5,000 token-equivalent units valid for 14 days.
- Keep the current evaluation workspace untouched (no data migration required).
- We'll log a billing note tied to DEAL-4582 so finance can reconcile once the PO arrives.

Ben, can you confirm we can approve the 5k top-up under the partnership discretionary credit? Marissa, looping you for CS handoff so we pair on the demo readiness checklist.

Natalie — if that works, reply with the expected PO sign date (even a window helps) and we’ll push the credits today.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0192
